description: Verify that DUT discards a UDP datagram with Length field == 0 (RFC 768 'Fields' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Length = 0 is illegal — the minimum legal value is 8 (the header alone). A receiver that accepted Length=0 would have to make up framing rules, opening parser-confusion attacks. RFC 768 requires it to be dropped.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: UDP datagram with Length field set to 0

2. Observation:
   • DUT's upper-tester must NOT receive the datagram (UT-query confirms drop)

[Pass condition]
UT-query confirms DUT did not deliver the Length=0 UDP.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_receipt — DUT delivered the Length=0 UDP (parser tolerated illegal length)
• Fail_timeout — UT-query never arrived (test infra issue)

verdicts.Pass: DUT discarded the Length=0 UDP — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_receipt: DUT received UDP with zero Length field
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No UT confirmation for zero-length discard
